---
title: "The verb you know"
---

You arrive holding another tool's word for it. This appendix is the index
for that direction: find the name you know, read the god words beside it,
and follow the link to the chapter that owns the idea. The other appendices
run the opposite way, from god's sentence outward.

The god column shows words, not whole pipelines, because most of these names
map to a word plus a place to put it rather than to a verb alone.

## From dplyr

| you know | god says | the chapter |
|---|---|---|
| `filter()` | `keep` | [Keeping rows](../chapters/keeping-rows.qmd) |
| `select()`, `select(-x)` | `pick`, `all_but` | [Choosing columns](../chapters/choosing-columns.qmd) |
| `mutate()` | `add` | [Adding a column](../chapters/adding-a-column.qmd) |
| `arrange()`, `desc()` | `sort`, `descending` | [Sorting and taking](../chapters/sorting-and-taking.qmd) |
| `group_by()` + `summarise()` | `summarize ... by` | [Summarizing by group](../chapters/summarizing-by-group.qmd) |
| `slice_head(n)`, `slice_max()` | `take`, `sort` then `take` | [Sorting and taking](../chapters/sorting-and-taking.qmd) |
| `slice_tail(n)` | `take_last`, after a `sort` | [Sorting and taking](../chapters/sorting-and-taking.qmd) |
| `distinct()` | `pick` then `drop_duplicates` | [Renaming and repeats](../chapters/renaming-and-repeats.qmd) |
| `rename(new = old)` | `rename`, same direction | [Renaming and repeats](../chapters/renaming-and-repeats.qmd) |
| `pivot_longer()` | `lengthen` | [Columns into rows](../chapters/columns-into-rows.qmd) |
| `pivot_wider()` | `widen` | [Rows into columns](../chapters/rows-into-columns.qmd) |
| `left_join()`, `inner_join()` | `join`, `unmatched` | [Another table](../chapters/another-table.qmd) |
| `semi_join()`, `anti_join()` | `keep(matching(...))`, with `not` | [Has a partner](../chapters/has-a-partner.qmd) |
| `bind_rows()` | `add_rows` | [Adding rows](../chapters/adding-rows.qmd) |
| `complete()`, `expand()` | `add_combinations`, with `by` | [The rows that are not there](../chapters/rows-that-are-not-there.qmd) |
| `case_when()` | `when ... otherwise` | [One way or another](../chapters/one-way-or-another.qmd) |
| `replace_values()`, `recode_values()` | `look_up`, with the ending written | [One way or another](../chapters/one-way-or-another.qmd) |
| `coalesce()` | `first_present` | [Missing values](../chapters/missing-values.qmd) |
| `across(starts_with())` | `where`, `name`, `value` | [One value per column](../chapters/one-value-per-column.qmd) |
| `row_number()`, `min_rank()` | `row_number`, `rank` | [Each row a place](../chapters/each-row-a-place.qmd) |
| `cumsum()`, `lag()`, `lead()` | `running_total`, `previous`, `following` | [The total so far](../chapters/the-total-so-far.qmd) |
| `sd()` | `standard_deviation` | [Summarizing by group](../chapters/summarizing-by-group.qmd) |
| `paste(collapse = )`, `stringr::str_flatten()` | `join_rows`, after a `sort` | [Tidying text](../chapters/tidying-text.qmd) |
| `slider::slide_dbl()`, `zoo::rollmean()` | `rolling(average(...), n)` | [The total so far](../chapters/the-total-so-far.qmd) |
| `show_query()` | `show_as`, with seven targets | [What it wrote](../chapters/what-it-wrote.qmd) |
| `collect()` | `collect`, the same word | [Nothing runs until you ask](../chapters/nothing-runs-yet.qmd) |

If you keep dplyr attached, four of the names in that column are also dplyr's:
`collect`, `pick`, `rename` and `summarize`. Three of them answer the same way
whichever package you attached last, and `pick` is the one that does not.
[The names other packages take
back](a-two-languages.qmd#the-names-other-packages-take-back) is the whole of it.

## From pandas

| you know | god says | the chapter |
|---|---|---|
| `query()`, boolean mask | `keep` | [Keeping rows](../chapters/keeping-rows.qmd) |
| `[[...]]`, `drop(columns=)` | `pick`, `all_but` | [Choosing columns](../chapters/choosing-columns.qmd) |
| `assign()` | `add` | [Adding a column](../chapters/adding-a-column.qmd) |
| `sort_values(ascending=False)` | `sort`, `descending` | [Sorting and taking](../chapters/sorting-and-taking.qmd) |
| `groupby().agg()` | `summarize ... by` | [Summarizing by group](../chapters/summarizing-by-group.qmd) |
| `head(n)`, `nlargest()` | `take`, `sort` then `take` | [Sorting and taking](../chapters/sorting-and-taking.qmd) |
| `tail(n)` | `take_last`, after a `sort` | [Sorting and taking](../chapters/sorting-and-taking.qmd) |
| `rename(columns={"old": "new"})` | `rename`, the other direction | [Renaming and repeats](../chapters/renaming-and-repeats.qmd) |
| `drop_duplicates()` | `drop_duplicates`, no subset | [Renaming and repeats](../chapters/renaming-and-repeats.qmd) |
| `melt()` | `lengthen` | [Columns into rows](../chapters/columns-into-rows.qmd) |
| `pivot_table()`, `pivot()` | `widen` | [Rows into columns](../chapters/rows-into-columns.qmd) |
| `merge()` | `join` | [Another table](../chapters/another-table.qmd) |
| `isin()` filter against a table | `matching` | [Has a partner](../chapters/has-a-partner.qmd) |
| `concat()` | `add_rows` | [Adding rows](../chapters/adding-rows.qmd) |
| `reindex(MultiIndex.from_product())` | `add_combinations` | [The rows that are not there](../chapters/rows-that-are-not-there.qmd) |
| `np.select`, nested `where` | `when ... otherwise` | [One way or another](../chapters/one-way-or-another.qmd) |
| `.replace({...})`, `.map({...})` | `look_up`, with the ending written | [One way or another](../chapters/one-way-or-another.qmd) |
| `fillna()`, `dropna()` | `fill_missing`, `drop_missing` | [Missing values](../chapters/missing-values.qmd) |
| `cumsum()`, `shift()` | `running_total`, `previous`, `following` | [The total so far](../chapters/the-total-so-far.qmd) |
| `std()` | `standard_deviation` | [Summarizing by group](../chapters/summarizing-by-group.qmd) |
| `.agg(", ".join)`, `.str.cat()` | `join_rows`, after a `sort` | [Tidying text](../chapters/tidying-text.qmd) |
| `sort_values(na_position=)` | `sort ... missing first`, or the default last | [Missing values](../chapters/missing-values.qmd) |
| `rolling(7).mean()` | `rolling(average(...), 7)` | [The total so far](../chapters/the-total-so-far.qmd) |

## From SQL

| you know | god says | the chapter |
|---|---|---|
| `WHERE` | `keep` | [Keeping rows](../chapters/keeping-rows.qmd) |
| `SELECT a, b` | `pick` | [Choosing columns](../chapters/choosing-columns.qmd) |
| computed column in `SELECT` | `add` | [Adding a column](../chapters/adding-a-column.qmd) |
| `ORDER BY ... DESC`, `LIMIT` | `sort ... descending`, `take` | [Sorting and taking](../chapters/sorting-and-taking.qmd) |
| `GROUP BY` with aggregates | `summarize ... by` | [Summarizing by group](../chapters/summarizing-by-group.qmd) |
| `SELECT DISTINCT` | `pick` then `drop_duplicates` | [Renaming and repeats](../chapters/renaming-and-repeats.qmd) |
| `JOIN ... ON` | `join ... by` | [Another table](../chapters/another-table.qmd) |
| `EXISTS`, `IN (SELECT ...)` | `matching` | [Has a partner](../chapters/has-a-partner.qmd) |
| `UNION ALL` | `add_rows` | [Adding rows](../chapters/adding-rows.qmd) |
| `CROSS JOIN` of two `DISTINCT`s, joined back | `add_combinations` | [The rows that are not there](../chapters/rows-that-are-not-there.qmd) |
| `CASE WHEN ... ELSE ... END` | `when ... otherwise` | [One way or another](../chapters/one-way-or-another.qmd) |
| `COALESCE` | `first_present` | [Missing values](../chapters/missing-values.qmd) |
| `RANK() OVER`, `ROW_NUMBER()` | `rank`, `row_number` | [Each row a place](../chapters/each-row-a-place.qmd) |
| `SUM() OVER (ORDER BY)`, `LAG`, `LEAD` | `running_total`, `previous`, `following` | [The total so far](../chapters/the-total-so-far.qmd) |
| `STDDEV` | `standard_deviation` | [Summarizing by group](../chapters/summarizing-by-group.qmd) |
| `STRING_AGG`, `GROUP_CONCAT`, `LISTAGG` | `join_rows`, after a `sort` | [Tidying text](../chapters/tidying-text.qmd) |
| `NULLS FIRST`, `NULLS LAST` | `sort ... missing first`, or the default last | [Missing values](../chapters/missing-values.qmd) |
| `AVG() OVER (ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)` | `rolling(average(...), 7)` | [The total so far](../chapters/the-total-so-far.qmd) |

One absence from all three tables is deliberate. There is no row for your
tool's way of applying an arbitrary function to a column, because god has no
word for it. The scalar vocabulary is closed, and the honest translation of
`apply` is the exit the last table in
[Appendix E](e-coverage.qmd) points at.
